articles.summary: DNS standards have caught up with modern infrastructure needs. RFC 9460's SVCB and HTTPS record types provide a standards-compliant alternative to CNAME flattening at the zone apex, unlocking HTTP/3 signalling, faster connection setup, ECH support, and clean DNSSEC compatibility without the workarounds proprietary ALIAS/ANAME implementations required.
articles.title: Beyond CNAME Flattening

articles.summary: An identity is useless if you can’t verify it. Agent Name Service (ANS) gives every agent an identity it can verify, a SCITT receipt tied to a transparency log, a status token that expires, and a proof of possession that bridges identity to OAuth 2.0. All of it verifiable offline, in fractions of a millisecond.
articles.title: Don’t Trust. Verify. Offline, Sub-Millisecond Agent Verification with ANS
